form_receipt_time: set by the organizer from the Google Form

problems.loads_sample_data: yes - seeded automatically (D1 migration + backend/seed.sql, 46 medicines spanning expired/soon/safe) and also loadable via file upload on the Import data page (JSON matching the judges' case format, agents/P02_pharmacy_expiry_public.json)

R1.evidence: 46-medicine stock list seeded in backend/seed.sql (name, batch, quantity, unit price, expiry per item), spanning already-expired, expiring-soon, and long-safe items. Quick Add on the Stock page lets the pharmacist add more.

R2.evidence: Overview page shows 4 group cards (expired / expiring <=30d / expiring <=90d / safe) with live counts, backed by GET /api/dashboard. Grouping is computed from the real current date, not stored. Verified against all 25 cases in agents/P02_pharmacy_expiry_public.json (25/25 pass).

R3.evidence: "Mark returned" button on the Stock page (POST /api/medicines/:id/return) moves an item to a separate Returned tab and excludes it from all active counts/values; "Undo" on the Returned tab reverses it.

R4.evidence: Overview page's risk banner shows total taka value at risk = expired.value + within30.value (quantity x unit price per clarifications R-27/R-04), refreshed on every load.

known_limitations: No authentication on any API endpoint, including the destructive POST /api/import and POST /api/demo/reset routes (they replace the whole stock list)
CORS is open to all origins on the backend
Company filter on the Stock page is an exact-match dropdown rather than free-text search (medicine name search is free-text)
